title: Apple HomeView (7-inch smart home display on a speaker base) goes on sale in India on Fri 13 Nov 2026 at ₹39,900 for both the tabletop and the wall-mounted model (pre-orders since 13 Oct); the wall model needs a Schneider Home mount sold separately: USB-C ₹6,900, AC wired ₹8,900, PoE ₹14,900 (early 2027), so at least ₹46,800 wall-mounted (idly's sum); recognises up to six people by face with their own home screen; up to nine camera feeds; controls Apple Home/Matter accessories; setup needs a compatible iPhone or iPad; Siri AI in English in India; A18 chip; $299 in the US
